title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: cross-membership cap on a single payment
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, a single payment transaction's applied amount toward an enrollment may never exceed 50 times the enrolled employee's own club membership monthly dues rate — obtained by reading that membership's own most recent recurring-dues charge on file, which reflects its tier's current rate — guarding against a single remittance overpaying relative to the household's overall billing scale.

Worked example (hypothetical): if an employee's own club membership monthly dues rate were $24.00, the cap on a single payment transaction toward their corporate wellness enrollment would be 50 times that rate, $1200.00; a remittance larger than that cap would still only have up to that cap amount applied.
